items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever play with Sam Morgan band? ... INTERVIEWEE: No, I never played with Sam.

ctx.x: Or Joe Oliver? Anita. What would be the best of the old time bands that you ever heard that you can remember? If you had to pick one band either that you played with or that you didn't play with that you used to hear at dances. What would be the best band that you can think of that you've heard?
Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.
Did they have a better beat than the other bands or what made them good? The tempo or what was it that made them good?
